attempts.note: Only ibipimo.org/www and demo exist (crt.sh); no developer portal.
Adaptor PR: built against the demo API for Burundi's health system team; no docs link (the team does not control the IBIPIMO API).
Route names occur only in the OpenFn adaptor; no vendor org or SDK ('ibipimo' is a common Kirundi/Kinyarwanda word, other hits unrelated).
No public workspace, collection or API.

notes: IBIPIMO is Burundi's HIV viral-load laboratory information system; its REST API is private, undocumented and fronted by ModSecurity (POSTs without the adaptor's User-Agent get 412). Modelled from the adaptor: the two named operations' routes POST /api/v1/post-viral-load-requests (201) and POST /api/v1/ask-for-vl-results (200), with request and response schemas taken from the live responses recorded in the adaptor README, plus GET /api/v1/samples/status and GET /api/v1/sites, which appear only as get() examples and in a test job and are flagged unverified (their response bodies are untyped). processViralLoadResults/processViralLoadSubmission are local helpers over these two responses and make no HTTP call. 'Full' means every route the adaptor surface evidences; the vendor's complete route list is unknown. Fixed from the July 2026 stub: response field names (saved_viral_load_samples/s_uid, not saved_samples/sample_uid), the 201 status for submissions, and invented Site/SampleStatus list shapes; real-looking patient names from the README example were not carried into examples.
